apple-200694651-2459.text:
The Apple Card & Savings team is building the financial products that put users in control of their money. We built Apple Card to reinvent how credit cards work, and we continue to launch groundbreaking features used by millions of people every day. We are looking for a technical lead who craves the challenge of architecting mission-critical systems at scale, sets technical direction across teams, and is equally at home in a design review, a production incident, or a technical negotiation with a financial partner.
You'll lead the architecture and evolution of the distributed services that power Apple Card and Savings, while staying hands-on in code and operations. You'll be given the flexibility to drive creative solutions, the support of a talented and driven team, and the autonomy and responsibility to take full ownership of critical systems.
Our team operates as DevOps: we build what we run. You'll shape the architecture of our platform through deep experience operating, monitoring, and supporting it on call, and you'll set the bar for how we ship and run software — safe, progressive releases, clear service level objectives, and automation over manual toil. You'll lead large, multi-quarter efforts — including complex integrations with financial institution and payment network partners and other Apple services — from conception through production, with reliability and customer trust as non-negotiables.
As a technical leader, you'll drive technical discussions across teams and organizations, write specifications, represent Apple in technical discussions with external partners, review code and designs, mentor senior engineers, and raise the engineering bar for the team. Success in this role requires strong self-motivation, crisp and clear communication, a highly collaborative approach, and the ability to define and influence engineering strategy well beyond your own team.
Architect, build, and operate mission-critical distributed services that power Apple Card and Savings at large scale
Lead large, multi-quarter engineering efforts — including complex integrations with financial institution and payment network partners — from conception through production
Drive technical discussions across teams and organizations, authoring specifications and representing Apple in external partner negotiations
Define and enforce service level objectives, progressive release strategies, and automation standards to eliminate manual toil
Lead incident response, extract operational learnings, and translate them into lasting architectural improvements
Review code and designs, raising the engineering bar and ensuring systems are built for testability from the outset
Mentor senior engineers and shape the engineering strategy and culture of the broader team
Define and champion the team's standards for AI-assisted development, evaluating and adopting tooling that measurably improves code quality and review throughput across the broader engineering org
Minimum Qualifications
A demonstrated track record of architecting, building, and operating mission-critical distributed systems at large scale, while remaining hands-on in code.
Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs in consistency, latency, and throughput, and of data correctness patterns (e.g. idempotency, exactly-once processing, reconciliation).
Expert hands-on software development skills in Kotlin or Java.
Extensive operational experience: leading incident response, defining service level objectives (SLOs), and turning operational learnings into architectural improvements.
A track record of leading complex, cross-team projects from conception to production — including large migrations or platform changes — and driving consensus with diverse audiences such as global teams and external partners.
A testing-first approach to engineering: designing systems for testability from the outset, writing tests as an integral part of development, and defining testing strategy (unit, integration, contract, end-to-end) for complex services.
No formal degree is required. What matters most is your mindset, your initiative, and your demonstrated ability to apply advanced skills to real-world applications.
Experience using generative AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle to produce high-quality software.
Preferred Qualifications
Deep expertise with Spring and with high-volume REST and/or gRPC services (server-to-server or mobile client facing).
Experience in payments, banking, or other regulated financial domains, including leading integrations with external financial partners and designing within compliance, consumer-protection, and privacy requirements (e.g. change management, separation of duties, PCI).
Experience architecting containerized, cloud-native applications (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, AWS) designed for multi-region resilience, failover, graceful degradation, and self-healing, and validated through load and failure testing.
Experience designing CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and progressive release strategies (e.g. canary deployments, feature flags, automated rollback).
Experience defining observability strategy (e.g. Datadog, Splunk, OpenTelemetry), including business-level monitoring and high-quality alerts that detect issues before customers or partners do.
Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging (e.g. Kafka or equivalent event streaming) and optimizing SQL/NoSQL databases for scale (e.g. Aurora, DynamoDB).
A strong understanding of security, privacy, and cryptography for protecting sensitive customer and financial data (e.g. mTLS, PKI and certificate lifecycle management, JWT).
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $216,200 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Our Human Interface Devices Software team delivers high-quality drivers, frameworks and tools supporting sensing technologies across all Apple products. Primarily supporting the multi-touch technology, we have deep experience developing systems software and building stacks that enable the best user-experience! We work closely with Algorithms, Firmware, Design, and UI teams to ensure sensor and software performance is optimized across all layers of the stack.
We are looking for an engineer to work on drivers, frameworks, and tools for iOS. In this role, you will maintain existing software and design new software stacks for future products and sensing technologies. Ideally, you have experience dealing with human factors, care deeply about user experience, enjoy supporting technology investigations, and are comfortable jumping between multiple levels of the software stack.
Minimum Qualifications
BS and 3 years of relevant industry experience
Experience developing system software; such as drivers or frameworks
Strong C/C++ and object-oriented programming skills
Excellent debugging skills
Ability to quickly familiarize yourself with code you’ve never seen before, and understand the pertinent functionality
Comfortable working at both higher and lower levels of software
Experience using AI-assisted development tools to enhance productivity in system software development flows, creating test frameworks and tooling, and improve overall code quality.
Preferred Qualifications
6 years of experience in developing embedded software, including firmware and device drivers
Using C/C++ for low level systems, and experience designing and implementing system software for drivers
Experience in Kernel driver development, including designing and implementing kernel drivers for various hardware sensors in Unix, Linux or iOS
Experience in designing and implementing SW interfaces/APIs among software, firmware and algorithms modules
Experience with profiling code in both kernel and userspace
Experience in debugging embedded system issues with hardware, assembly and software tracers
Strong verbal and written communications skills
Self-advised, analytical, and works well in a team environment

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring curiosity, passion, and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish!
Our Camera Incubation team is a multi-disciplinary team responsible for looking down the road and prototyping new experiences, architectures and technologies. We collaborate with design and product teams to bring new features across the Apple product line. Join us as together we explore concept prototypes, helping shape what intelligent cameras can sense, understand, and do—and the experience they create for the people who use them.
We're looking for a creative ML Research Engineer to join our incubation team, where you'll work across the full stack, from model training and systems integration to rapid prototyping. While working on a diverse portfolio of exploratory projects, you'll bring deep practical knowledge of ML/AI architectures and multimodal sensing applied to physical spaces, paired with a design-centric approach to moving ideas from experiment to integrated system. The ideal candidate is energized by open questions, comfortable navigating ambiguity, quick to reorient when new data shifts the direction, and always able to clearly articulate the motivation, tradeoffs, and risks behind their approach.
Minimum Qualifications
BS and a minimum of 3 years relevant industry experience in machine learning or AI engineering
Familiarity with state-of-the-art architectures including transformers, reinforcement learning, and predictive inference
Strong coding skills across modern ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), with a practical approach to tooling that includes AI-assisted development as a natural part of the workflow
Proven experience building end-to-end ML pipelines, from data acquisition and preprocessing through training, evaluation, and deployment
Experience architecting and integrating sensing systems that fuse multimodal signals (e.g. vision, audio, IMU, LiDAR) with ML models running on mobile, wearable, or robotic platforms
Preferred Qualifications
MS or PhD with substantial applied research experience in a relevant area
Ability to clearly communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and rationale to both technical and non-technical collaborators
Demonstrated comfort with ambiguity and a track record of adapting quickly when direction shifts
Experience working in a research, incubation, or early-stage exploratory environment
Familiarity with on-device or edge ML deployment and its associated constraints
Background in robotics, embedded systems, or real-time sensing pipelines
Knowledge of practical Bayesian reasoning and methods
Experience with physics-based machine learning — including physics-informed neural networks, simulation-to-real transfer, or learned physical models
Cross-disciplinary collaboration experience — hardware, software, design, and research

apple-200694649-2459.text:
The Apple Card & Savings team is building the financial products that put users in control of their money. We built Apple Card to reinvent how credit cards work, and we continue to launch groundbreaking features used by millions of people every day. We are looking for an experienced engineer who loves owning critical services end to end, takes pride in operational excellence, and thrives in a highly regulated environment where correctness, reliability, and compliance requirements shape every technical decision.
You'll design, build, test, deliver, and operate the distributed services that power Apple Card and Savings — from applications, accounts, and transactions to payments, savings transfers, rewards, and customer notifications. You'll be given the support of a talented team, access to modern technologies, and the autonomy to take full ownership of your work.
Our team operates as DevOps: we build what we run. You'll be hands-on in every phase of the lifecycle — shipping changes safely through automated pipelines and controlled rollouts, participating in an on-call rotation, joining incident response and post-incident reviews, and automating away operational toil. You'll build reliable integrations with financial institution and payment network partners and with other Apple services such as Wallet, Apple Cash, and iCloud.
As an experienced member of the team, you'll own features from specification through production, review code, contribute to technical design, write clear documentation, and help onboard and mentor teammates. Success in this role requires self-motivation, clear communication, a collaborative approach, and a commitment to engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
Design, build, test, and operate distributed backend services powering Apple Card and Savings features at scale
Ship changes safely through automated pipelines and controlled rollout strategies including canary deployments and feature flags
Own on-call reliability for your services, lead incident response end to end, and drive post-incident reviews that produce lasting remediation rather than one-time fixes
Own the reliability and correctness of integrations with financial institution partners and payment networks, including defining SLOs and leading remediation when those targets are breached
Own features end to end from specification and technical design through production operation
Review code and contribute to technical design discussions, raising the quality bar across the team
Write thorough unit and integration tests and design code with testability as a first-class concern
Automate operational toil to improve reliability and reduce manual intervention
Author clear technical documentation for services, APIs, and operational runbooks
Mentor and onboard new teammates, sharing knowledge and best practices
Minimum Qualifications
Solid experience building and operating production distributed systems, including services you have supported on call.
Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including idempotency, retries, timeouts, and consistency trade-offs.
Proficiency in a modern backend programming language (e.g. Kotlin, Java).
Experience debugging production issues using logs, metrics, and traces, and following through on fixes and post-incident improvements.
A testing-first mindset: experience writing thorough unit and integration tests as a natural part of development, and designing code with testability in mind.
Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues to non-engineering stakeholders and external partners.
No formal degree is required. What matters most is your mindset, your initiative, and your demonstrated ability to apply advanced skills to real-world applications.
Experience using generative AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle to produce high-quality software.
Preferred Qualifications
Production experience with Kotlin and Spring at high transaction volumes, including tuning JVM performance, managing connection pools, and maintaining API contracts across multiple concurrent client versions.
Experience in payments, banking, or other regulated financial domains, including data correctness (reconciliation, audit trails) and working within compliance, consumer-protection, and privacy requirements.
Experience with containerized, cloud-native services (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, AWS), including multi-region resilience and failover.
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and safe release practices (e.g. canary deployments, feature flags, automated rollback).
Experience with observability tools (e.g. Datadog, Splunk, OpenTelemetry), service level objectives (SLOs), and building actionable alerts that detect issues before customers or partners do.
Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging (e.g. Kafka or equivalent event streaming) and with SQL/NoSQL databases at scale (e.g. Aurora, DynamoDB).
Understanding of security and privacy fundamentals for protecting sensitive customer and financial data (e.g. mTLS, PKI and certificate lifecycle management, JWT).

apple-200694577-0836.text:
Apple is where we use the power of technology to enrich people's lives. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.
Join the Apple Ads Engineering team and help build an advertising platform that benefits both customers and advertisers. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV — helping people discover content, supporting creators and publishers, and connecting advertisers of all sizes with engaged audiences, all with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. In this role, you will design, develop, and launch the highly-performant, internet-scale backend systems that select and deliver the right ads in real time, collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure to bring elegant solutions into production at Apple scale.
You will design, develop, and operate the distributed services that make real-time ad selection possible at Apple. You will architect and build low-latency, high-availability, high-throughput ad-serving systems in a cloud environment, engineer secure and scalable data processing pipelines that operate on petabyte-scale datasets, and implement performant services that handle very high data volumes and QPS. You will work cross-functionally to ensure that optimal and correct ads are available for real-time selection, and that observability and flexibility are provided for stakeholders. While this role focuses on the candidate retrieval part of Apple Ads, we are not constrained by organization structure and offer the flexibility to contribute across a variety of backend systems, including opportunities to apply algorithmic search, machine learning, NLP, and AI to hard retrieval problems. You will write clean, efficient, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and mentor other engineers on the team. Collaboration with internal partners across indexing, search, serving, operations, and program management to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions is essential. You should be passionate about building products that protect user privacy and thrive in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities — and have fun doing it.
Architect, design, and implement internet-scale, low-latency, highly-available ad-serving systems in a cloud environment.
Build performant micro-services and distributed data platforms that support high data volumes and QPS.
Engineer secure, scalable distributed data processing pipelines capable of processing petabyte-scale datasets for indexing and retrieval.
Apply techniques from algorithmic search, machine learning, natural language processing, and AI to advance candidate retrieval and ranking.
Collaborate with multiple internal teams to support indexing and searching use cases across the organization.
Partner with product managers, operations, SREs, and fellow engineers to define requirements and deliver end-to-end systems.
Work effectively both independently and as part of a team to deliver complete systems from design through production.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code and participates in code reviews.
Debug and resolve complex issues across large-scale distributed systems.
Stay current with advances in search, retrieval, distributed systems, ML/AI, and cloud infrastructure, and contribute ideas that improve the platform.
Minimum Qualifications
6+ years of industry experience architecting and developing internet-scale server software for Linux systems, including scalable micro-services or data-driven platforms.
Strong background in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
Strong coding skills in Go, Java, Rust, C++, Scala, or a similar OOP/Functional language.
Hands-on experience designing and operating scalable micro-services.
Experience with search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, or Elasticsearch. Expertise with NoSQL datastores (e.g., Cassandra).
Proficiency with data processing technologies (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Flink) and methods for processing petabyte-scale datasets.
Experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, EC2, and EKS/Kubernetes. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Demonstrated ability to work on complex problems and systems, alone or as part of a team, to deliver complete systems end to end.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams, including operations and project management partners.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience creating groundbreaking technology for algorithmic search, machine learning, natural language processing, and artificial intelligence.
Experience building ad-serving, recommendation, or large-scale retrieval systems.
Familiarity with real-time bidding, candidate retrieval, or ranking pipelines.
Experience operating services with strict latency and availability SLOs.
Familiarity with privacy-preserving system design and data-handling practices.
Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals — consensus, replication, and fault tolerance.
A desire to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment, and a fast learner with strong motivation for growing and learning new technologies.

Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

apple-200687791-3337.text:
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds the container and virtualization runtime technology that powers Apple's next-generation compute platform. We're a fast-moving, highly skilled team of systems engineers designing and developing the virtualization-based runtimes that run Virtual Machines and Linux Containers across our data center and Apple platforms — with privacy, security, and performance as first-class requirements. Beyond the datacenter, we maintain Apple Container, our open source project bringing native container support to macOS desktops.
We're looking to add talented, passionate seasoned domain experts who love hard systems problems and want to build foundational technology used across Apple and the open source community, ready to take ownership of significant technologies.
We build the container runtime technology that Apple's own services and developers depend on. Our systems engineers develop virtualization-based runtimes — using macOS virtualization and VMM solutions like Cloud Hypervisor and sandboxed container solutions — to run Virtual Machines and Linux Containers across our data center and Apple platforms, with a relentless focus on privacy, security, and performance. This is a foundational systems team: we work at the level of kernel and container security, image distribution, filesystems, and virtualization. Much of this work is greenfield, solving problems unique to running on Apple's own hardware in the data center, at a scale and with constraints the rest of the industry hasn't had to solve for. Beyond the datacenter, we maintain Apple Container, our open source desktop tooling that lets developers around the world run containers natively on macOS.
We're looking for a domain expert with depth across multiple technical areas, someone used to designing major features and resolving highly complex, ambiguous problems creatively — taking ownership of significant technologies to drive real impact across the organization, ready to take risks, course-correct quickly, and drive ideas from inception to implementation, building a reputation as someone the broader org seeks out for technical direction and standards, and to actively mentor engineers at all levels.
We love open source and collaboration at every level.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent related experience.
At least 3 years of software design and development experience in infrastructure engineering (compute, storage and network virtualization) with an emphasis on micro-services architectures and containerization
Advanced programming language proficiency in C, C++, Swift or Go, with a track record of designing and developing high performance, secured, scalable and reliable systems
Hands-on experience with some or all of the following topics: Linux containerization, Linux filesystems, Image distribution, Content storage, Kernel and container security
Track record of owning technical design end-to-end — from design docs and architecture tradeoffs through implementation and review
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Linux system programming
Experience leading code review for team standards, correctness, and test coverage, and raising the technical bar for other engineers
Experience defining and executing test strategies (regression prevention, negative-case validation, security testing) for complex systems
Development experience in one or more of: Cloud security, Container / Linux Kernel security and API security
Experience troubleshooting and diving into metrics to identify resource contention and bottlenecks
Experience designing benchmarks and load tests to characterize performance and establish scalability models
Development experience with container orchestration systems such as Docker or Kubernetes is a plus
Development experience with virtualization and container technologies such as Apple Container, Kata, Firecracker, or KubeVirt is a plus
Systems programming experience on Darwin with Swift is a plus
Programming system virtualization based on Cloud Hypervisor, rust-vmm, macOS Virtualization Framework, QEMU, or KVM is a plus
Understanding of various shared networked storage solutions (iSCSI, NFS, cluster file systems) is a plus

apple-200694095-0836.text:
Apple is where we use the power of technology to enrich people's lives. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.
Join the Apple Ads Engineering team and help build an advertising platform that benefits both customers and advertisers. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV — helping people discover content, supporting creators and publishers, and connecting advertisers of all sizes with engaged audiences, all with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. In this role, you will design, develop, and launch the highly-performant, internet-scale backend systems that select and deliver the right ads in real time, collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure to bring elegant solutions into production at Apple scale.
You will design, develop, and operate the distributed services that make real-time ad selection possible at Apple. You will architect and build low-latency, high-availability, high-throughput ad-serving systems in a cloud environment, engineer secure and scalable data processing pipelines that operate on petabyte-scale datasets, and implement performant services that handle very high data volumes and QPS. You will work cross-functionally to ensure that optimal and correct ads are available for real-time selection, and that observability and flexibility are provided for stakeholders. While this role focuses on the candidate retrieval part of Apple Ads, we are not constrained by organization structure and offer the flexibility to contribute across a variety of backend systems, including opportunities to apply algorithmic search, machine learning, NLP, and AI to hard retrieval problems. You will write clean, efficient, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and mentor other engineers on the team. Collaboration with internal partners across indexing, search, serving, operations, and program management to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions is essential. You should be passionate about building products that protect user privacy and thrive in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities — and have fun doing it.
Architect, design, and implement internet-scale, low-latency, highly-available ad-serving systems in a cloud environment.
Build performant micro-services and distributed data platforms that support high data volumes and QPS.
Engineer secure, scalable distributed data processing pipelines capable of processing petabyte-scale datasets for indexing and retrieval.
Apply techniques from algorithmic search, machine learning, natural language processing, and AI to advance candidate retrieval and ranking.
Collaborate with multiple internal teams to support indexing and searching use cases across the organization.
Partner with product managers, operations, SREs, and fellow engineers to define requirements and deliver end-to-end systems.
Work effectively both independently and as part of a team to deliver complete systems from design through production.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code and participates in code reviews.
Debug and resolve complex issues across large-scale distributed systems.
Mentor other engineers and contribute to engineering best practices.
Stay current with advances in search, retrieval, distributed systems, ML/AI, and cloud infrastructure, and contribute ideas that improve the platform.
Minimum Qualifications
6+ years of industry experience architecting and developing internet-scale server software for Linux systems, including scalable micro-services or data-driven platforms.
Strong background in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
Strong coding skills in Go, Java, Rust, C++, Scala, or a similar OOP/Functional language.
Hands-on experience designing and operating scalable micro-services.
Experience with search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, or Elasticsearch. Expertise with NoSQL datastores (e.g., Cassandra).
Proficiency with data processing technologies (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Flink) and methods for processing petabyte-scale datasets.
Experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, EC2, and EKS/Kubernetes. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Demonstrated ability to work on complex problems and systems, alone or as part of a team, to deliver complete systems end to end.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams, including operations and project management partners.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Experience creating groundbreaking technology for algorithmic search, machine learning, natural language processing, and artificial intelligence.
Experience building ad-serving, recommendation, or large-scale retrieval systems.
Familiarity with real-time bidding, candidate retrieval, or ranking pipelines.
Experience operating services with strict latency and availability SLOs.
Familiarity with privacy-preserving system design and data-handling practices.
Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals — consensus, replication, and fault tolerance.
A desire to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment, and a fast learner with strong motivation for growing and learning new technologies.

Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product and service we create results from us strengthening each other’s ideas. That happens because we believe we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better.
Do you want to push the limits of the best mobile phone camera in the world? The Creative Intelligence team features a diverse engineering roster, including software engineers, color and imaging scientists and ML experts. We work at a fast pace and require everyone to be highly self-motivated.
The Color Imaging and Standards team develops novel imaging technologies and new software features for the next generation of Apple cameras. Our goal is to improve image quality and enable new capture experiences by trying new things! We start by exploring new ideas, testing them by building proof-of-concept demos, reviewing images to confirm customer benefits, and then implementing the best ideas in our ecosystem.
We delivered algorithms that drive some of the iPhone cameras’ groundbreaking features, such as HDR photography. We are passionate about photography and strive to build new innovative features that let users unleash their creativity in ways they never thought possible – we want to work with people with the same desire!
We're looking for people who are passionate about cutting-edge photographic experiences. Join us to learn more about image quality, dive into our cameras' features, and explore new ideas!
We are looking for an enthusiastic imaging scientist who can help us build new camera technologies and experiences. This position focuses on the identification, exploration, and prototyping of image processing technologies for future Apple products.
You will work on small and large cross-functional projects and interface with other software and hardware engineering teams.
A successful candidate will not only need to identify new tech and be able to problem-solve outside of their respective technical area, but also educate a broad audience of people at Apple about their benefits and tradeoffs.
Inventing and implementing innovative image processing algorithms or user experiences.
Exploring novel imaging applications and features integrating hardware and software, demonstrating feasibility through modeling and prototyping.
Collaborating with your team members to prepare presentations, talks, and disclosures to explain your inventions.
Collaborating with other teams in software, firmware, and hardware to ensure the highest possible image quality.
Minimum Qualifications
Strong engineering background in color imaging, image processing, or image quality.
Deep knowledge of digital photography and camera components.
Prior experience prototyping new technologies, developing algorithms, and writing proof of concept software.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Strong presentation and communication skills.
M.S. or Ph.D. in Imaging, Color, Vision, Computer, Optics Science, EE, or equivalent with 3+ years of experience in a related field.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in HDR imaging, from capture to display, and tone mapping.
Knowledge of optics, signal processing, color perception, human vision system, and mathematical modeling.
Experience with digital photography, color, and imaging processing pipelines and architectural designs, including graphics and rendering
Capable of prototyping, conducting design of experiments, and analytical data processing.
Familiarity with ISO/ICC and related imaging standards.
